ahrc.definition: Something that is lifted up and carried. The lifting up of the voice in song.
Used as a function word to indicate movement or an action or condition suggestive of progress toward a place, person, or thing reached.

To raise one's voice or speak loudly and with urgency; to give, a name; to meet in the sense of being called to a meeting; to have an encounter by chance; to read in the sense of calling out words. Edenics: call - with the exchange of the l and r
The act or the duty of protecting or defending; to watch over or guard in the sense of preserving or protecting. To keep watch. Alternate Translations: guardian (when written in the participle form)

Interrogative expressing inquiry about the identity, nature, or value of an object. Can also be why, when or how. Alternate Translations: how; why; how many (when prefixed with " like~ "); what is the reason (when prefixed with " to~ " and followed by the word " THIS ") Alternate Spellings: מה
